description: Exchange a signup(handoff: true) handoff_token for the tenant key it was issued for. Single-use: a second redemption fails with handoff_token_redeemed; past its expiry it fails with handoff_token_expired. Unauthenticated -- the token itself is the proof.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.redeem
